'''''Ryloth''''' was an advertisement for [[Ryloth (beverage)|the beverage]] of the same name, put up on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and showed a beautiful [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] landscape (the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that the drink was named after) at night, lit by one of the planet's [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. One version of the ad was put up as a giant [[Painting/Legends|poster]] at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], but it was mirror-inverted and faded. A complete, un-mirrored copy appeared in the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]].<ref name="Lethal" />
